Special thanks to [Arashi] and [Garsche] from discord and twitch for playtesting the song! Go check them out! Thank you guys so much!

________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________

EDIT: IMPORTANT NOTE!

Due to the song receiving mixed reviews while having vision problems, I have decided to rework this song. The vision aspect was originally intended as part of the difficulty, but after experience, I have learned that this idea is unacceptable in Beat Saber. With that said, I will be making adjustments soon in order to improve vision and flow while maintaining the same speed. Most parts will be kept, but I will definitely change the parts most players struggle on.

I will leave this version available if you still wish to experience the original version of "Lonely Departure - Chroma". But keep in mind that there will be a reworked version with better vision and flow. Feel free to delete this version as well. I'll leave that up to you.

Please look forward to the changes. I hope you will enjoy the new version!

name: [RANKED] Kaneda7 - TOGETHER
description:
1/18

This is the first of 18 songs I plan on mapping from Kaneda7's first standalone project.

This collection of 18 songs were never originally released as a full album but were confirmed by the artist to be part of the same broader project. They also all share the same cover art of Laura Palmer from Twin Peaks.

Kaneda's music is extremely special to me. While his art usually consists of extremely dark themes, hearing someone able to not only speak about their darkest thoughts, but also able to turn it to some of the most beautiful art I've experienced, is extremely comforting to me. Kaneda's music has helped me throughout the darkest most horrible times in my life, and now is no exception. 

I have decided I want to dedicate my time to allow you all to experience his music in a way that feels intentional, immersive, and true to the emotion behind his words. 

For each of these I want to write my thoughts on the song and tell you why I enjoy it.

The chorus starts with lyrics I believe have a double meaning. "I ain't a model, god wish I had an icepick". Kaneda talking about his own struggles with body dysmorphia really resonates with me as a trans woman who experiences dysphoria daily. As for the double meaning I believe he is referencing Canadian killer Luca Rocco Magnotta. I personally find killers like Luca extremely fascinating and I have always loved learning about serial killers and their psychology. Learning about them helps me manage and understand my own irrational thoughts and feelings. Kaneda uses a lot of niche references like this that people within the scene will recognize. As for the rest of the chorus I choose to believe he is speaking about potential romantic partners. I have had partners cheat on me, use me, abuse me, rape me, and worse. Hearing those lines framed in such a detached, almost numb tone makes it hit even harder for me. It feels less like shock value and more like someone processing pain in the only way they know how. These would be the actions of an incredibly hurt individual. The struggle with his own self image layered with references that are this disturbing mirrors how intrusive and dark thoughts can feel when you’re already struggling internally. name: niki - -ERROR (Tokoyama Towa Cover)
description:
Imagine using windows to emphasize vocals.
Going for ScoreSaber ranked with beest mod jabye.
Old version (RIP Shrado mod): https://beatsaver.com/maps/3a975

Expert+ = 8.1 stars balanced.

August 18th, 2024 Update: Finished RT mod by yabje, entering ScoreSaber queue.
October 26th, 2024 Update: Partially followed QAT requests to use less doubles, RT mod by Slayx, various smaller changes.
October 30th, 2024 Update: Finished RT mod by Slayx.

name: [Ranked] Swedish House Mafia - It Gets Better
description:
Lawless preview (somewhat old): https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=Xk1Z0aEh1ak

Third Swedish House Mafia map, for the third year of my Beat Saber journey

Inspired by old mappers and their triangle maps back in 2019, I made a funny optional triangle concept that I decided to rank this time. Was originally invert dot notes but I think is probably more fun to relive the glory of old days.

No difference between ex+ standard and lawless apart from one "triangle" that apparently breaks scoresaber rank algo.

Massive thanks to @Joshabi for the RT modding & giving me the idea on improve the middle part of the song it’s actually a banger, and Alice for the timing check

name: [200th Map] Porter Robinson - Something Comforting (Nolanimations Remix)
description:
Well here we are, big map 200. I created this track specifically for this occasion, and I couldn't be more proud of it, both song and map. 

When I made my first map I thought that there'd be NO WAY that this would become a regular thing I'd be doing and yet here we are, what a crazy journey it has been. TWO-HUNDRED maps, so many hours stuck into little side-gig.

I'm proud of what I've achieved up to this point, the friends I've made, the awards my maps have somehow won me, the musical experience I've gained just from listening to these songs just a little closer. 

Thank you all for supporting my work throughout the years, it means the world to me <3

description:
I did not make this map myself....
Prepare yourself for a heavenly journey through the rhythmic realms of "Strawberry Milk," a meticulously crafted Beat Saber map by the legendary mapper and devout Jesus lover, Sketchur31. Embark on a sensory adventure that blends the sweetness of strawberries with the creamy richness of milk, all set to an electrifying soundtrack that will uplift your spirit and challenge your skills.

As you step onto the virtual stage, you'll find yourself surrounded by a vibrant landscape painted in hues of pink and white, reminiscent of a sun-kissed strawberry field. The air is infused with the tantalizing aroma of ripe berries, heightening your anticipation for the melodic journey ahead.

Guided by Sketchur31's masterful hand, every slice and dice of the beat is choreographed with precision, ensuring a seamless fusion of music and motion. From the gentle swaying of blades to the thunderous crescendos that demand your utmost focus, each note serves as a testament to the mapper's unparalleled skill and dedication.

As you dance to the rhythm, you'll find yourself swept away by the infectious energy of the music, your movements flowing effortlessly as if guided by divine intervention. With each successful strike, you'll feel a sense of satisfaction wash over you, knowing that you're not just playing a game, but engaging in a transcendent experience crafted by a true artist.

But beware, for amidst the euphoria lies a challenge that will test even the most seasoned players. As the tempo rises and the notes come crashing down like a torrential downpour, you'll need to channel your inner strength and agility to emerge victorious. Yet fear not, for with perseverance and faith, you'll conquer every obstacle that stands in your way.

So gather your courage, sharpen your senses, and immerse yourself in the wondrous world of "Strawberry Milk." Let Sketchur31's passion and devotion guide you as you embark on a journey that transcends the boundaries of reality, leaving you with memories that will linger long after the final note fades away.

name: Kobaryo - Unlimited Hyperlink [Ranked]
description:
Preview: https://youtu.be/jBL0Vq82BHo

Hello!

After comfortably beating the 10 Star mark with multiple maps, I've been trying to map something close to or above 11 Stars for a long time. I've had various attempts at different songs that I've ultimately abandoned since I wasn't quite happy with them.
I'm happy to say that I've finally made a really difficult map that I'm 100% proud of.

I've put a lot of thought behind this map and in a lot of ways it's the result of over 4 years of mapping experience for me, and thus also marks my retirement from mapping.

I'm open to return to it in the future, but for now I have other things in my life which are more important to me.

Descriptions are rarely read, but if you've made it this far and perhaps know some of my other maps or have seen my name floating around in the ranked scene, I really want to thank you for sticking around and (hopefully) enjoying my maps.
Mapping has been a big creative outlet for me ever since I got the game, even though I stopped playing over 2 years ago by now.
A massive thanks to everyone that I've had the pleasure of interacting with in the community, it's been a ton of fun :)
You're all fantastic

Cheers,
Timbo

name: [RANKED]  Camellia - Exit This Earth's Atomosphere
description:
star estimate:
ex+ - 10.3-10.6
ex - 9-9.5
hard - idk 6.5-7.5?
h

this map has taken me 36 hours to make since september 2022,  nearly 22 of them being on expert+

for rank :)))
theres no modern ranked maps for this despite it being like one of the most popular camellia songs ever?
this was so fun to map though and hopefully just as fun to play
its by far the best mapset ive ever made
i know ex+ isnt perfect but hopefully a mod should polish out the tech (i am a speed mapepr)

expert+ - 340 bpm jumps with some tech at the end
expert - 170 bpm jumps with one handed 340 bursts and bomb resets at the end
expert was originally just gonna be a downmap, but i realised i had tons of mapping ideas for this song i didnt get to do with expert+
so although it is easier, it can basically be its own map

reup 1:
tons of fixes thanks to feedback and my own more nitpicky playtesting
ex+ - fixed some walls, made some playability fixes and moved some stuff around
ex - literally remapped the second half of the last drop cause bomb resets became boring, made the first half of the outro less dull, improved representation
also forgot to relight to account for map changes, but that will probably effect nobody so ill fix it next time

reup 2:
uploaded under new link cause beatsaver reupload limit
relighted to account for map changes
ex+ - finally fixed a bad cutty hit ive refused to remove since the very first version of this map in september 22 cause lobster proved to me why

reup 3:
ex+ - fixed 2 bad cutty hits on the first half of the last drop

reup 4:
ex+ - made some tweaks to the tech section (removed vision block, tweaked angles, removed weird palm up)

reup 5: 
THANK YOU IRISH FOR HELPING ME WITH THE EX+ INTRO EVEN THOUGH YOU CANCELLED THE RT MOD :(( AND THANK YOU AVEXUS FOR THE REVIEW ALL OF YOUR FEEDBACK REALLY HELPED

name: [RANKED] im_naku - Stagestruck (nolanLMOA's "Shooters in Detroit" Bootleg)
description:
Ok wow this is actually pretty cool. This is the first map (I think) of NolanLMOA's latest remix! It's really boppin' and I'm actually super proud of it. It’s a full spread, and it’s got all your lovely difficulty desires.

Reup #1 for full spread
Reup #2 has cool downmap mod by Goji_Crafter and major changes added to Expert+
Reup #3 (I pray that this is the final version before rank) has all the quality of life changes, including the slider bit being changed and the outro
Reup #4 kill me
Reup #5 no way Shrado mod holy hell this is gonna get ranked finally
Reup #6 most likely the final version of this. Thank you everyone who's given me feedback
Reup #7 Joshabi QAT mod for downmaps AND a Yabje mod??? This is amazing!
Reup #8 This will be the last ever version, as the map is now qualified with some quality fixes pointed out by bitzy boo. Thanks to everyone who's helped me on this map.

Star Estimate: 10.25* (I was close)

Enjoy.

All complains can be sent to SuperMemer417#3522

description:
Best "Alternative" Style Map 2022
Auto Mapped using Bomb Sage™

MAP PREVIEW (youll need it) - https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=9mf2yR2SE8k

Scariest map in beat saber creation
Collaboration on Ex+ With BITZ!! @gBitz
Shoutout to Skeelie for letting us use their lightshow! @skeelie
Thanks @joshabi for the feedback!!

4k bombs good luck

Star Estimate: 11.3

MARENOL Lore------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
Every day, I keep a dream journal.
Some people say that over time it might start making dreams feel like real life
and that's dangerous...but I haven't felt that way.
More than that, people say it's a good way to improve one's mental health.
But it seems like that's true of all routines.
For me, it's just fun. Reading back on it, it's like I have more memories.
Dreams and memories are about the same thing once they're in the past, so it doesn't feel far from the truth to say they really happened to you.
But it's actually really hard to write a dream journal...they slip out of your memory so easily.
The details slip away from you as you write.
You have to record them as fast as possible.
Apparently professional interviewers don't use words at all.
They just use a personal system of simple symbols to record everything.
But I can't do that sort of thing....so I frequently miss days. It's difficult to be accurate, too.
...in writing my journals, I've lately had a disproportionate number of bad dreams. And they feel so real.
Death is a given, and often I'll suffer for a long time without dying.
I'll immediately wake up after death, but just before it feels like reality.
Pain, suffering...nothing but that. Recently sleep itself has become scary, no, terrifying.
Since I'll feel the pain of death every time I sleep...I think it's a little impressive to keep writing dream journals even through that.
...maybe the way all that pain resets when I wake up
is the real motivation for my journals.
Since I might really die someday.
And I can only think of one reason why I've been having all these bad dreams. That drug.
 
Marenol.
An antidepressant I got hold of myself instead of being prescribed.
I'm, well, depressed. I took the drugs I was prescribed at first, but they didn't do anything.
I've done counseling, too, but I never had any confidence in it.
Unsurprisingly, I soon stopped medicating, and soon I lost the will to go outside.
Even leaving my room became a challenge. I stopped eating, started collapsing and vomiting.
Even though there was nothing to vomit up...heh.
For better or for worse, in the middle of all that, I found an antidepressant on the internet.
I wasn't actually looking for one...
Instead, while I was looking for suicide methods without any intention of actually going through with it, it showed up in some automatic interstitial.
(Is it really a good thing to stop people who want to die?)
Its main effects: powerful antidepressant properties, mood enhancement, healing depression itself, nutritional supplementation, with a very long tail of effectiveness...nothing short of perfect.
But I was more interested in the side effect. "Dreams so bad they approach death."
I was dubious of whether they were actually that bad,
But having "recovery" as a main effect and "death" as a side effect is sort of win-win for someone suicidal.
And dream journals had almost made bad dreams a little fun.
And there are a lot of drugs with bad dreams as a side effect.
It's hard to tell if the drugs actually cause them or they were happening anyway...
So apparently it's really not that big a deal.
I really didn't think it would be that bad...in retrospect, I was overconfident.
I just took a bunch without paying too much attention to the instructions.
I figured, hey, I've OD'd before.
 
Thinking back, since it was on a suicide site...it must have been intended for "that".
Something that only people prepared for "that" would use.
At the very least, it was all true. Dreams like living hell. I die over and over again.
The pain, no different from real life.
I knew that suicide by overdose was painful, but...it was stupid to attempt something like this.
Oh god, I want to die. Or...am I already dying? Christ, please.
I know I said I wanted to die, but not this terribly.
The worst part it...when I'm awake, I feel fine.
I'm almost sickeningly happy. It's a little amazing that it's so effective I'm able to write this.
But...it's all a trap. It's like the main effect is death, and the side effect is wanting to live.
It wouldn't be that bad if it was just dying in a dream, but...
It all hurts just as much as if it was real life.
"Dreams so bad they approach death"...I thought it was talking about dying in the dream.
But I've heard of people dying because their dreams felt so real their brains went into shock.
So maybe it was talking about death in the real world. If so...I know I'll die that way.
It feels so real, I can't tell how I'm still alive.
Just make it either a dream or real, please...it's not like it makes a difference.
The pain of being impaled by a lance, being crushed by the ceiling, of starving for oxygen as I drown...
Even though it's just a dream, it's all real to me.
There's nothing I can do but wait until the effects run out.
Even though it's been days since I took it, it's still in my system.
I have no idea how long it lasts...and until then, there's nothing I can do but die, over and over again.
But I have no other options...a punishment I inflicted on myself.
If I die, it'll be with no external injuries...no one will be able to tell what killed me.
That's why I'm writing all this here...both my life and my dreams.
 
Good night.

name: (Ranked) Silentroom vs Frums - Aegleseeker
description:
Trivia
This is the first Side Story song to have its FTR difficulty rated as 11.
As such, this makes it the second non-anomaly song, preceded by SAIKYO STRONGER, to possess a FTR 11 chart.
This song also possesses the highest BPM out of all songs that have FTR/BYD 11s charts, at 234BPM, narrowly beating Tempestissimo.
This is one of the first songs in which Lagrange appears in a song jacket. The other song is Far Away Light.
This is the first song in the game which is locked behind a Potential and Partner unlock requirement.
SAIKYO STRONGER is the first song in the game to be locked behind a Potential requirement only.
This is the first non-anomaly song to have all three of its difficulties greyed out and displayed as "?" prior to meeting the unlock requirements.
This is also the first song ever to do so with its song title, artist and BPM information displayed before being unlocked.
Formerly, Aegleseeker's PRS chart used to be rated as level 8, which made it the only level 11 chart in game not to possess a level 9 chart. However, this is no longer the case as of update 4.0.
As of update 3.6.0, its FTR chart currently has the second highest note count out of all charts in the game.
This is only surpassed by #1f1e33's FTR chart, with 1576 notes in total.
The FTR chart also has the highest note count in all level 11s currently in the game, surpassing the BYD chart of Tempestissimo by 28 notes.
Despite the variable timings in the middle section of the song, Silentroom has stated that the entire song is in 4/4 time.
Similar to overdead., there are notes at the end of the song that do not have to be touched.
Despite that the game can be fully played offline except for World Mode, the Future chart of this song becomes the first song to be unavailable for offline or guest play due to a bug that will uncheck the potential requirement.
As of now, the bug stated above no longer exists. However a new bug was found where upon experiencing the Present difficulty to unlock Lagrange's skill, the game automatically unlocks the Future difficulty regardless whether the player has at least 11.00 potential or not.
Aegle is a term in Greek Mythology that means "brightness" or "dazzling light" (Written as Αἴγλη). The name is also used for many Greek deities. Thus the song's name literally means 'brightness-seeker'.

name: [Ranked] SG Lewis - One More (feat. Nile Rodgers) [Chroma]
description:
Expert+ Preview: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=NxheJNZgtMo

No way, non-microwave music as ranked map!

Fullspread beatmap of a disco masterpiece by SG Lewis, featuring the legendary disco guitarist from Chic, Nile Rodgers. This is the fourth map that I've been talking about since the release of Flight Facilities "Stay". I started this back in February, right after Sugar (I think I’ve spent 40% of my mapping hours on just this map at this point). It has Chroma lights; It might not be the best map out there but I put my heart working on this, just because I love and appreciate this song so much.

I want to thank @Alice (https://beatsaver.com/profile/4234633) for all the help she’s given for me to make this map happen in the first place. I don’t know how much I owe her, not only for newbie queue RT modding, but also giving me guidance throughout the entire journey of mapping this song (yes, from February).

Also thanks to Catse, Tastum, @namaki_mono, and @Calvinisacat for playtesting throughout iterations of the map.

If you're curious why would you have a friend in a bathroom stall, just ask me on:
- https://twitch.tv/daftmaple, or
- https://twitter.com/daftmaple

description:
Part of the Alphabeat Remaster - OST 3 Pack | Presented by the Alphabeat Mapping Group.
Get the playlist here: https://beatsaver.com/playlists/5201

Alphabeat takes the mantle from Ramen Noodle, and continues the OST Remaster legacy. Featuring recreations of the OST 3 maps from 6 members of the team, with 5 difficulties for all skill levels - and full vanilla lightshows!

Full spread, as per usual.
Duck walls in Hard, Expert, and Expert+.
Easy and Normal have no duck walls and are catered toward new players.

Additional thanks:
Playtesting: @nitronikexe, @Timeweaver, @Dee-Dee, @Reddek, @Artjoms, Kryptecc, SyndicateVR, Morgolf, Dietah. 
Thanks to @Timbo for the RT mod!

Check out all the other mappers and lighters for this pack:
@Timeweaver
@Firestrike_
@Pixelguy
@AkaBaka
@McChucho

Enjoy the map. And enjoy the lights.

Keep up to date with Alphabeat releases: https://twitter.com/AlphabeatBS

name: Ori and the Blind Forest - Escaping the Ruins
description:
In all my years of playing video games..........few games managed to really steer an emotional attachment quite like Ori and the Blind forest.

Apart from amazing art work, fun gameplay, sad and eventful story - the soundtrack is superb and magnifies the experience - credit to the composer **Gareth Coker** for such an amazing score and **Aerali Brighton** for her angel like vocal voice.

Some claimed the soundtrack was so good that it made them tear on the menu screen already.......having mapped that OST already, it's time to move on to yet another amazing OST !

I would like to thank @monster  @3stans and  @Kaltern-Is-It and the BSMG for testing the map and proving much needed feedback !
Also, special thanks to @Phoenix_5  for helping me tackle some of the drifting BPM issues the song had ! :)

This map will feature **5 total difficulties**, with 2 modes - *One Saber* included !

If you wish to view the map, while following Ori and Sein on their adventure, go no further and watch Ori himself perform the song ! :3 - https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=JYIQAdXuTYw

Another option, view the map it from the eyes of two beat saber pros, !
Javierattor, with his awesome skills at mapping and playing alike playing the Standard difficulty ! ;)
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=eEe3SW6pcKE

Or, sir CaptainMeme, playing the One Saber Difficulty ! :)
https://youtu.be/DwEOnqyO6AE

I would also like to credit the artist Shupa Mikey for his amazing artwork, check out his video on how this current maps artwork came to be and with a spicy animation at start ! https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=rAqPNgqmGis

Forwarding the story narration and elaboration of the previous Main Menu track,The Spirit Tree and Climbing The Ginso Tree and Restoring the Light, Facing the Dark and The Waters Cleansed.
It's time to move on with the story for those interested ! :D

SPOILER AHEAD for those who have not played the game and do wish to one day !

..........................................................................................................................................................................
..........................................................................................................................................................................
..........................................................................................................................................................................

With the restoration of the waters of Nibel, the way forward to the Forlurn Ruins is now open !
Similar to the Ginso Tree, before Ori and Sein will be able to enter the ruins, they must first acquire a key to open it.

The ruins, being the home of the Gumon, require them to find the Gumon Seal, located deep in the Misty Woods.........
The woods themselves might prove a challenging obstacle for Ori and Sein, for it is told that all that many creatures that have gone in, never got out............

Setting their sights on the goal, Ori and Sein enter the Misty Woods at last, and they are immediately greated with the forests core feature - a thick fog that greatly hinders their sight......
Besides the fog itself, it feels as though the forest is possesed by some sort of wicked magic........for when they tried to back track their way, they failed to recognize the way they came....
The forest is ever changing, possessed by unknown magic that leave many confused and lost.......

Fortunately, Seins wisdoms once again helps them on their journey, for Sein knows that the source of the fog is caused by the Shrouded Lantern, which resides in the forest and can be dispelled if they manage to find Atsu's Torch, an item thought lost in the woods but might still be found......
Ori and Sein set sight on the item, and continue to wander the foggy forest.......

............................................Time goes by......................................................................

Success has blessed Ori and Sein, for their persistence and hard work has led them to find the torch at last !
Retracing their steps, they approach the Shrouded Lantern and insert the torch, immediately clearing the mist !
Paving the way forward and restoring the since of direction, they find the Gumon Seal at last !

Now the way forward to the Forlurn Ruins is all but open, and thus, they head off to next destination.......

.........................................Time goes by yet again................................................

On their way to the ruins, Ori and Sein freeze at their steps, for it appears  Kuro is on the prowl once more.......she appears to be observing the fields, looking to settle the score with Ori after his lucky escape from her grasp.....

As Kuro blocks the way to the ruins, Sein suggest they distract her by crumbling a huge mass of rocks that so happens to be right above her head......
Bashing through the air and reaching the rocks, Ori uses the very strength of his ancestrals to smash the rocks on Kuro !

Stunned by the ordeal, Kuro flees, while lossing some of her feathers in the rushed escape.
Ori, descending back to where Kruo flew from, finds one of her massive feathers, which can be used to glide the winds in these lands !
Somehow, Ori believes this feather will surely prove useful in the coming journey........

With the way forward open once again, Ori and Sein arrive at the ruins at last, they insert the Gumon Seal and enter the ruins.
When the enter, they discover a horrific scene.......all of the Gumos have frozen to death, for without the winds that carried warmth air, their home became their grave......

Sein, saddened by the sight, motivate Ori to keep on going and restore the winds for the sake of the Gumo kind, which also saved Ori from Kuro the other day !

As they venture deeper into the ruins, said Gumo arrive at his home after recovering his sanity through the kindness Ori showed how, only to discover his fellow kin at their unfortunate state......
With sad eyes, Gumo turned his attention to Ori and Seins actions, to see investigate what brought them to his home.

Ori and Sein discover a Light Vessel, a gift that was given to the Gumo by the spirit tree in a gesture of good will in the past.
Taking the Light Vessel, they discover that it holds the key to activate many mechanicals aspacts in the ruins that are needed to safely traverse.
And so, they head off.....

..........................................Time goes by..................................................

After slowly traversing the ruins with the Light Vessel, Ori finds an iconic pedestal which appears to be designated for the insertion of the Light Vessel.
As they insert the vessel, the stairs to the core suddenly open up !

Climbing the stairs , Ori and Seing at last stand before the Forlurn Ruins core.......the second element of Nibel, ready to be restored !
As Sein approaches the core, she says the following sentence :

Sein : "The Elements of Wind lies before us, stored in the heart of this place!"
"These Ruins are all that is left of the Gumon, reminding us of their fate....."
"Losing the ones that he love, Gumo is the last of his kind....."
"Ori, we shall bring back the light ! for Nibel and the memory of the Gumon ! let us restore the Elements of Wind ! "

All the while Gumo was below them, catching up to their trail and hearing each word,
once more stunned by the sheer kindness Ori and Sein showed him.....

Gumo decides to take action, as Sein begins to chants her magic once more and restore the core, Gumo quickly grabs the Light Vessel Ori inserted in the pedestal, for he knows the best way he can repay him for his kindness...

As Sein restores the core, all the pieces come together and become whole once more !
However....... little did they know that the restoration of the core will cause it to emit a powerful shockwave, one that will shake the entire ruins !

As the shockwave travels through the ruins, the very ground beneath Ori begins to shake and crumbles beneath his very feet !

Falling down, Ori quickly deploys the feather he has acquired from Kuro, and glides the newly restored winds from the core upwards and towards the exit......which is unfortunately riddled with spikes, falling stones and powerful winds !

Once more, similar to the Ginso Tree, Ori and Sein must find their way out, before they find their grave at the elements hands !

Will Ori and Sein safely reach the exit before the ruins collapse on their very heads ?

..........................................................................................................................................................................................

Next Chapter -  Riding The Wind ( https://beatsaver.com/maps/236ea)

The woods themselves might prove a challenging obstacle for Ori and Sein, for it is told that all that many creatures that have gone in, never got out............

Setting their sights on the goal, Ori and Sein enter the Misty Woods at last, and they are immediately greated with the forests core feature - a thick fog that greatly hinders their sight......

Bashing through the air and reaching the rocks, Ori uses the very strength of his ancestrals to smash the rocks on Kuro !

Stunned by the ordeal, Kuro flees, while lossing some of her feathers in the rushed escape.
Ori, descending back to where Kruo flew from, finds one of her massive feathers, which can be used to glide the winds in these lands !
Somehow, Ori believes this feather will surely prove useful in the coming journey........

With the way forward open once again, Ori and Sein arrive at the ruins at last, they insert the Gumon Seal and enter the ruins.
When the enter, they discover a horrific scene.......all of the Gumos have frozen to death, for without the winds that carried warmth air, their home became their grave......

Sein, saddened by the sight, motivate Ori to keep on going and restore the winds for the sake of the Gumo kind, which also saved Ori from Kuro the other day !

As they venture deeper into the ruins, said Gumo arrive at his home after recovering his sanity through the kindness Ori showed how, only to discover his fellow kin at their unfortunate state......
With sad eyes, Gumo turned his attention to Ori and Seins actions, to see investigate what brought them to his home.

Ori and Sein discover a Light Vessel, a gift that was given to the Gumo by the spirit tree in a gesture of good will in the past.
Taking the Light Vessel, they discover that it holds the key to activate many mechanicals aspacts in the ruins that are needed to safely traverse.
And so, they head off.....

..........................................Time goes by..................................................

After slowly traversing the ruins with the Light Vessel, Ori finds an iconic pedestal which appears to be designated for the insertion of the Light Vessel.
As they insert the vessel, the stairs to the core suddenly open up !

Climbing the stairs , Ori and Seing at last stand before the Forlurn Ruins core.......the second element of Nibel, ready to be restored !
As Sein approaches the core, she says the following sentence :

Sein : "The Elements of Wind lies before us, stored in the heart of this place!"
"These Ruins are all that is left of the Gumon, reminding us of their fate....."
"Losing the ones that he love, Gumo is the last of his kind....."
"Ori, we shall bring back the light ! for Nibel and the memory of the Gumon ! let us restore the Elements of Wind ! "

All the while Gumo was below them, catching up to their trail and hearing each word,
once more stunned by the sheer kindness Ori and Sein showed him.....

Gumo decides to take action, as Sein begins to chants her magic once more and restore the core, Gumo quickly grabs the Light Vessel Ori inserted in the pedestal, for he knows the best way he can repay him for his kindness...

As Sein restores the core, all the pieces come together and become whole once more !
However....... little did they know that the restoration of the core will cause it to emit a powerful shockwave, one that will shake the entire ruins !

As the shockwave travels through the ruins, the very ground beneath Ori begins to shake and crumbles beneath his very feet !

Falling down, Ori quickly deploys the feather he has acquired from Kuro, and glides the newly restored winds from the core upwards and towards the exit......which is unfortunately riddled with spikes, falling stones and powerful winds !

Once more, similar to the Ginso Tree, Ori and Sein must find their way out, before they find their grave at the elements hands !

Will Ori and Sein safely reach the exit before the ruins collapse on their very heads ?

..........................................................................................................................................................................................

name: Ori and the Blind Forest - Restoring the Light, Facing the Dark
description:
In all my years of playing video games..........few games managed to really steer an emotional attachment quite like Ori and the Blind forest.

Apart from amazing art work, fun gameplay, sad and eventful story - the soundtrack is superb and magnifies the experience - credit to the composer **Gareth Coker** for such an amazing score and **Aerali Brighton** for her angel like vocal voice.

Some claimed the soundtrack was so good that it made them tear on the menu screen already.......having mapped that OST already, it's time to move on to yet another amazing OST !

I would like to thank  @TheCzar1994  @scarladore and  @Kaltern-Is-It  for providing much needed feedback to better capture the experience of this great journy !

This map will feature **5 total difficulties**, with 2 modes - *One Saber* included !

Standard Expert preview by Javierattor  - https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=FvNI2CvyoEc

One Saber Expert preview by Sir CaptainMeme - https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=QEPyegJZpl8

Map preview by......a Special guest for the Ori fans ! :D
(Be warned as it has spoilers at the end ! for it has an original phase after the song ends ! ) https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=rRZKheO0GCA

Forwarding the story narration and elaboration of the previous Main Menu track,The Spirit Tree and Climbing The Ginso Tree, it's time to move on with the story for those interested ! :D

SPOILER AHEAD for those who have not played the game and do wish to one day !

.......................................................................................................................................................................

At long last, after an intense journey that invloved climbing, fighting and puzzle solving, Ori and Sein found themselves several feet above ground.
Just like Sein predicated, with the moon high in the sky and Midnights darkness once more, they reached the heart of the Ginso Tree.......
Only to find it wraped and tainted with thorns whom prevent their approach!
They will have to work their way into removing said thorns before setting their sights on the heart's purification.

.........................................A few puzzle solving and environmental bashing later......................

With the last thorn leaving it's grip from the heart of the Ginso Tree, Ori and Sein approached the heart.......
The hearts condition was at a very bad state, dry, corrupt and dirty with no guidence of light.....
However, Sein, being the wisp of Nibel, was the one to maintain the hearts life all these seasons with the Spirit Tree and can surely use her profound powers to once more make the waters flow !

And thus, Sein approached the Heart, with the magic of the Spirit Tree,  she chanted forth a spell that sent a bright light into the heart......
Suddenly, an intense shockwave rose from the core and outwards !
The heart of the Ginso Tree has been  resparked and beats once more !

However.........up ahead, Ori's ears perked as he suddenly heared an intense sound.........the sound of gashing water !

Looking below, a river of water is heading towards them like the dams of the world were flunged open !

Initially panicking, Ori thinks of any means of escape, he can't allow himself to end his life once more here while the forests death is still at hand !

With Sein's quick thinking, she advises they flee and escape through the roof of the tree, which they do and begin the run of thier life !

Can Ori and Sein reach the top of the tree alive and save the forest or will they be washed by the impending waters they sought to purify ?

................................................................................................................................

Next Chapter ! The Waters Cleansed - ( https://beatsaver.com/maps/1ee25)

(Be warned as it has spoilers at the end ! for it has an original phase after the song ends ! ) https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=rRZKheO0GCA

Forwarding the story narration and elaboration of the previous Main Menu track,The Spirit Tree and Climbing The Ginso Tree, it's time to move on with the story for those interested ! :D

SPOILER AHEAD for those who have not played the game and do wish to one day !

.......................................................................................................................................................................

At long last, after an intense journey that invloved climbing, fighting and puzzle solving, Ori and Sein found themselves several feet above ground.
Just like Sein predicated, with the moon high in the sky and Midnights darkness once more, they reached the heart of the Ginso Tree.......
Only to find it wraped and tainted with thorns whom prevent their approach!
They will have to work their way into removing said thorns before setting their sights on the heart's purification.

.........................................A few puzzle solving and environmental bashing later......................

With the last thorn leaving it's grip from the heart of the Ginso Tree, Ori and Sein approached the heart.......
The hearts condition was at a very bad state, dry, corrupt and dirty with no guidence of light.....
However, Sein, being the wisp of Nibel, was the one to maintain the hearts life all these seasons with the Spirit Tree and can surely use her profound powers to once more make the waters flow !

And thus, Sein approached the Heart, with the magic of the Spirit Tree,  she chanted forth a spell that sent a bright light into the heart......
Suddenly, an intense shockwave rose from the core and outwards !
The heart of the Ginso Tree has been  resparked and beats once more !

However.........up ahead, Ori's ears perked as he suddenly heared an intense sound.........the sound of gashing water !

Looking below, a river of water is heading towards them like the dams of the world were flunged open !

Initially panicking, Ori thinks of any means of escape, he can't allow himself to end his life once more here while the forests death is still at hand !

With Sein's quick thinking, she advises they flee and escape through the roof of the tree, which they do and begin the run of thier life !

Can Ori and Sein reach the top of the tree alive and save the forest or will they be washed by the impending waters they sought to purify ?

................................................................................................................................

name: Camellia - BANGER A.F. , BROOOOO!!! [Ranked]
description:
I'm proud to present the epic Timbo Camellia triple super duper pack!(real)

Containing 3 ranked maps, all above 10 Stars, with 5 diffs each, adding up to a total of 69:50 Minutes of Map!
Spanning various mapping styles, from acc and dance all the way to speed and tech! Everything is included :D

This has beenmy most ambitious project yet, and after 4 months of work I'm finally ready to release it!

Thank you so much to everyone that helped me make this happen, special thanks to Sync who gave feedback on all lower diffs of all three maps in video format, it's greatly appreciated!
Thanks to all the RT modders for putting these maps in queue and, most of all, thank YOU for playing my maps <3

All of these maps have a great amount of effort put into ALL diffs, I really hope the acc community will get a kick out of the lowers! :D

Blastix = Speed, Muzzle = Tech and Banger A.F = a mix of both!


-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
About Banger A.F. :
This was the first map of the bunch that I made.
The original upload was a lot harder but I've reduced the difficulty to make it more balanced.

Special thanks to:
Sync for QA testing the 3 lower diffs,
Abcbadq for the excellent lawless diff, which is his first version of the currently ranked one,
and Slimyblob for modding!

Thank you so much to everyone that helped me make this happen, special thanks to Sync who gave feedback on all lower diffs of all three maps in video format, it's greatly appreciated!
Thanks to all the RT modders for putting these maps in queue and, most of all, thank YOU for playing my maps <3

All of these maps have a great amount of effort put into ALL diffs, I really hope the acc community will get a kick out of the lowers! :D

Blastix = Speed, Muzzle = Tech and Banger A.F = a mix of both!


-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
About Banger A.F. :
This was the first map of the bunch that I made.
The original upload was a lot harder but I've reduced the difficulty to make it more balanced.

Special thanks to:
Sync for QA testing the 3 lower diffs,
Abcbadq for the excellent lawless diff, which is his first version of the currently ranked one,
and Slimyblob for modding!

name: Ori and the Blind Forest - Main Theme
description:
Edit : Coming back to the Ori maps, with the release of  the Grand pack it's time to improve the lore of the story.

In all my years of playing video games..........few games managed to really steer an emotional attachment quite like Ori and the Blind forest.

Apart from amazing art work, fun gameplay, sad and eventful story - the soundtrack is superb and magnifies the experience - credit to the composer **Gareth Coker** for such an amazing score and **Aerali Brighton** for her angel like vocal voice.

Some claimed the soundtrack was so good that it made them tear on the menu screen...............so in order to give a glimpse of that said soundtrack - allow me to take you on a journy to this titles Main Theme with brewed effects that each represent a season 🌱 🍂 ❄️☀️⛈️  ! (a better experience now that the map is ranked ! )

This map will feature **5 total difficulties**, with 2 modes - *One Saber* included !
Each difficulty has a unique color setup to emphasize a season in a rain forst or a stormy night as labeled  in-game,

I would like to thank @vaser888  @Kaltern-Is-It and the BSMG  for once again providing much needed feedback in order to make the most out of a map :)

Map previews :

Standard Expert preview by Javierattor - https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=FGh0D1aYwCs

One Saber Expert preview by Sir CaptainMeme - https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=V5DGy1YjTGM

Map preview by......a Special guest for the Ori fans ! :D - https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=kGtL8iZvzvU
From here on, I will elaborate a bit on the games story from an original brewed and narrated POV based on my understanding of the story and hypothesis, those of you who wish to read, stay tuned below ! :)

A bit of a SPOILER ahead, though not too much as some of it is written from an original POV.


.........................................................................................................................................................................................

.........................................................................................................................................................................................

 *I will refer to Ori as in male tongue and Sein in female, though it is not stated anyware so it is by no means a declaration of it's gender*
...........................................................................

The realm of Nibel........a secluded wonder that no foreign visitor has ever been able ot grace his eyes upon..........
Housing many wondrous and unique creatures, from it's intelligent Gumo race to huge owls that dominate the skies, it radiates prosperity and harmony !

Balanced and maintaned by the 3 core elements :

The Elements of Water - the tallest tree in the forest - The Ginso Tree is responsible for the clean and flowing waters of Nibel, allowing the lush vegetation to grow and provide clean water to it's inhabitants.
The Element of Wind - the home of the Gumo race, the Forlurn Ruins, responsible for forming and carrying the winds of Nibel so it's seeds could spread and it's birds fly high into the trees.
The Elements of Warmth - the active and controlled Mount Horu, a volcano that provides the forests inhabitants with warm climates in the harshest of winters and nights.

All of these elements however, have one overseer in Nibel.
In the middle of the forests, lies an abnormal tree..........one that helps balance the three elements and their cycle - The Spirit Tree.

A wonder on it's own, for once it was but a mere "Spirit", but after joining with a wisp and by the will of the wisps, became a tree that maintains the forest well being.
Said wisp that joined with the former spirit and now be called a tree is called Sein, which resides inside the Spirit Tree and together, birth new spirits that may continue the cycle shall the wisps deem it.

Said spirits are beings of light, similar to rabbits with a posture of an ape and hooves like horses.
They are the children of the Spirit Tree, who care deeply for each and every one of his children.

The forests cycle of life has been outgoing for many moons, from the coldest Winter' to the hottest Summer with the relief of the Fall and Spring.
However.......one night, a malicious storm formed in the skies of Nibel, a storm so powerful, that it caused a chain of events that will throw the realm into chaos !

What events will the storm unfold on Nibel ?

introducing - Ori and the Blind forest ! 
..........................................................................................................................................................

Hope you enjoy the map ! :)

description:

Standard Expert preview by Javierattor - https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=1vXsWudZJnQ

Map preview by......a Special guest for the Ori fans ! :D  - https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=DTYv7HyhaX4

Forwarding the story narration and elaboration of the previous Main Menu track, it's time to move on with the story for those interested ! :D

SPOILER AHEAD for those who have not played the game and do wish to one day !
............................................................................................................
............................................................................................................
............................................................................................................

Forwarding from the last chapter......(https://beatsaver.com/maps/1cb68)

**CRACK!**

Was the sound of roaring thunder in the now black skies.
As the sun gave way to the moon, the utter darkness that shrouded Nibel made room to the malicious storm that formed in the plains.

The Spirit Tree, which has experienced his fair of harsh weather, stood his ground while the winds tried to throw his branches of balance.
However, just then, a strong gush of wind coupled with rain tore a leaf from one of his branches !

Said leaf housed an unborn Spirit - Ori, who was now lost in the storm and drifted far away from the spirit tree........

Watching helplessly as his child drifted off, the Spirit Tree could only hope he would land safely........

From afar, one of the forests residents - a bear like creature by the name of Naru, watched the storm and suddenly noticed a bright leaf passing by her....
Curiously, she went to investigate the matter and followed the leafs trail.......... untill it landed safe and sound on a nearby rock.
Suddenly, the leaf transformed and took the shape of a newly born spirit !

Thus, Ori was born, helpless and vaunrable to the elements, with him being still asleep.

Naru, feeling the need to protect a helpless and new-born baby creature, got closer and embraced Ori like a mother to son and decided adopt him as one of her own kin, taking him back to her cave.........

The Spirit Tree watched from afar, relived to see his son in safe hands, for being acquainted with Naru -  knew he could not of asked for a better foster mother......


..........................Time passes, and so does the cycle of seasons....................


It has been many moons since the dreadful night that tore Ori from his home.

Since then, Naru, Ori's foster mother, embraced him as one of her own and taught him the ways of life........ one that included gathering fruits, building bridges to cross rivers and of course, plenty of eating......

However, The Spirit Tree had not quite given up and accepted Ori's fate of being a lone Spirit all his life, for he knows he belonged with his kin and sensed that great things await for his child of light.....

Patiently he waited for an opportunity to signal his sons roots....
With a plan set in motion, The Spirit Tree decided to wait for a faithful night that he will light the skies ablaze with his light, a signal Ori will surely follow !

............................The faithful day.........................

Ori and Naru were once again on the hunt for food, together they started the morning with a need to cross a river and reach a pile of fruits on the other side.
Being used to each other by now and working out a plan, they spent the entire day building a bridge that would carry them across - and so they did !
After spending the entire day planing, building, coordinating and lifting - they made it to the other side !
 With a shout of joy they embrace each other..........and proceed to gather their prize.

While they did so, the moon was once more fast appriaching, as night time has once more fallen uponNibel......
With it..... was time the time for the Spirit Trees plan.....

Naru and Ori were feasting on their prized pile of fruits.
Ori decided to grab a batch and save it for the morning - thus he went to return back to their cave for the night.
On his way, he climbed a hill he always used to take that provided a grand view of Nibel.

However.....as he reached the peak, he was star strucked !
The Spirit Tree initiated his plan, he was all but ablaze and radaited spirit energy !

Ori, looking into the Spirit tree's light, could not avert his gaze.........from the sheer shock he dropped all the batch he was carrying on the ground and felt....drawn to the light.
Suddenly, his trance was broken as he got picked up by the panicked Naru !
Garbbing Ori, she quickly rushed to the cave, avoiding the bright light !

The Spirit Trees plan has sadly failed, he could not voice his words to his son and will have to wait for yet another chance.....
However, one does not just disturb all of the night creatures......for his actions were not without consequences.....
 Uknown to him, he has distubed a mighty night creature that did not take a kind approach to his bright display.......and thus, invoked it's wrath !

A terrible tragic night followed thereafter........

....................Time passes................................

Naru and Ori continued their life the next day and  the following seasons....unaware of the events that occured the previous night.....

The Spirit Tree has lost it's power over Nibel, for a raid on the sacred plains of hollow bough has occured due to his impulsive light show which has disturbed a mighty night ceature.......
 
Slowly, with the ongoing moons and seasons, the lack of supervision and magic of the Spirit Tree has taken it's toll.

The waters became murky, the trees died, the winds ceased and failed to carry it' seed and  the warmth became unstable and harmful.....

Slowly but surely, Naru and Ori felt it's effect as well........

With no trees or clean water, they were starving, as their last batch of food contained by a mere one fruit....
Naru gave it to Ori so that he may live while starving herself out, just like a mother would do....
Ori, determined to find food for his mother, set out to scavenge.....

name: Imil - My Album Is Out On Dance Corps So Now I Am Allowed To Do A Dancecore Yay!
description:
P.S. There are NO triangles/double directionals in this map, but due to the strangeness and technicality of a lot of the patterns (readability-wise and intensity of twists), it might be easier to triangle some of the patterns. Though since the map was intended to have no triangles, you might have to cancel the triangle with another one everytime you do. Good luck!

Well

A.) There just seems to be almost no flow at all. I found the 90 degree streams to flow the best, which shouldn't be the case.
B.) A lot of the parts in the song that are the same are mapped with extremely different difficulty scaling.
C.) I get that you are trying to make high pp tech, but spamming the hell out of really uncomfortable angles is not the way to do that.
There is a small joke going around right now about how we are going back to 2018 mapping, this map unironically feels that way to me.

I try not to be biased against this type of mapping even though I don't like it in general, but I think most people would agree with me on these statements.

Playtesting: @Artjoms, @ezConfirmed, and many others
Public mods: @ThySpoon, Hikari, Scoop

Keep up to date with my maps: https://twitter.com/fatalution

name: Pendulum – Come Alive [Chroma]
description:
Has Chroma lights. Please install Chroma and enable all effects for the beautiful Chroma 2.4.9+ lightshow.

Give it some time to load. The map has a lot of lighting events 🙂
This is a ranked remap of the map. All difficulties received remaps and various fixes.

I love Pendulum. And their new track is awesome.
Hence, the map. It was in production for a long time.
Also, interesting new lighting effect on rings I haven’t seen used anywhere before 🙂

Full spread, as per usual. Don’t shy away even if you are a new player, you will find the difficulty suitable for you.
Expert+ is challenging and has some wristrolls. Beware 😀

Lightshow preview: https://youtu.be/buXOdFX2pvM
Gameplay preview and comparison with the OG version: https://youtu.be/zTAyCYIlQpE

Additional thanks:
Huge thanks to @Timbo for the RT mod!
Public QAT mod: @ThySpoon.
Playtesting: @Artjoms, @ThySpoon, @Timbo, Nymph, Approxima, and many, many others.
Additional mapping advice: Too many people to list. Thanks to all of you <3

Enjoy the map. And enjoy the lights

Keep up to date with my maps: https://twitter.com/fatalution
Would love to hear your feedback: Fatalution#3973

name: JIN - Additional Memory
description:
Ayano's song from Kagerou Project

A remastered version of one of my first multi-difficulty maps, Additional Memory.
I have spent the time to rework the lower difficulties with some nicer angles, fixed poor lead-ins, bad cuts,
poor rhythm choices and issues with expert+ so that it flows better, plays better and represents the song better,
as well as relighting most of the original map which was originally auto-generated.

A MAJOR thank you to Alice for helping with fixing the rhythm choices, never took the time to fix them from the old version and she was a massive help bringing new life to the map <3

Map Preview: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=miX5HkLxils

name: Apashe - Uebok VIP [Chroma]
description:
Has Chroma lights. Please install Chroma and enable all effects for the beautiful Chroma 2.4.9+ lightshow

It is Apashe. It bops.
Gotta run. And play.

@ThySpoon asked for it to be ranked. It is now ranked. 

Easy and Normal difficulties would be comfortable even for the new players to play.
Hard is...where it should it be - in the middle of Expert and Normal.
Expert is dancy.
Expert+ is dancy and challenging at the same time.

Lightshow preview: https://youtu.be/gAxUbQcx290
Gameplay preview: https://youtu.be/Hcs1dmW9IK4

Additional thanks:
Huge thanks to @that_narwhal for the RT and QAT mod, and @Jabob for the RT mod!
Playtesting: @that_narwhal, @ThySpoon, Nymph, Approxima.
Additional mapping advice: @a-jhintleman and others in the awesome Beat Saber Mapping community.

Enjoy the map. And enjoy the lights

Keep up to date with my maps: https://twitter.com/fatalution
Would love to hear your feedback: Fatalution#3973

shrado: Thank you so much for getting in a call and giving me a ton of feedback, I really appreciate it!

Foxy: Thank you so much for the QAT feedback! Helped add a little more polish to the final result!

description:
As of 2021/04/18 this Map is Ranked!
{Hurray for my first ranked map!!! (:D)>=}


First of all...

A MASSIVE THANK YOU to Nolanimation and xScaramouche, from ScoreSaber's Discord Server, for taking the time and effort to Mod what this Map originally was -- A DISASTER -- and to Narwhal for speed suggestions, advice and the re-queue!
As well, for being punctual, professional and teaching me many important things!
I hope this new version conforms to the invaluable information I've learned.

Right! So...

This Map has Ranked status on all 3 Standard Difficulties.
Because of this, you can earn PP for playing it!


This Map features--

1. Growing "Memory Walls."-
An evolving vision block. -- Special Diff's only.

2. Window "Stacks."-
More challenging to gauge. -- Expert+ Diff's only.

3. Bomb Resets and Alerts.-
For easier fore-reading. {Not really.} -- All Diff's.

4. Fast and High Diagonal Stacks, Crossovers, Doubles, Streams.-
Please be careful about how you play if you are inexperienced. -- Especially Special Expert+.

5. 5 Messy, Special variants under NoArrows(They have Arrows...) Similar to the Standard Diff's.-
These are technically harder, faster and less forgiving. Only attempt if you can handle your controllers quite well. If not, expect probable CLASHES.

6. Forced Environment/Saber/Block Colors in the Special Diff's for those with SongCore.dll and its Custom Colors option active.-
WAU~


Questions, Comments, etc. to Pekini Pei#3974 on Discord.


https://youtu.be/5CG9sHMqouE

^(Old Speeds - Minor Deviation from Current Version)

Have Fun!

name: Brooks & KSHMR - Voices (feat. TZAR)
description:
Thanks to testplayers and modders. Modded by altrewin.

finally a 128bpm ranked map that has an effective tempo of 128bpm daayyyum

Preview: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=6c_x8MIzZLA

Did I get my inspiration from Saut and/or Kizuflux? No. This map is the cumulative result of a series of test maps I put together to gather information on which unconventional patterns are the most fun to play to certain people. There is still much to be learned so I'm taking feedback on discord @Halcyon12#1337.

Easy: Notes: 434 NPS: 2.31 NJS: 12
Normal: Notes: 547 NPS: 2.91 NJS: 13
Hard: Notes: 634 NPS: 3.37 NJS: 15
Expert: Notes: 752 NPS: 4.00 NJS: 17
Expert+ "Illusionary": Notes: 877 NPS: 4.66 NJS: 19

Uses Chroma lighting events. It is suggested to play with Chroma installed.

name: Bring It On - Giga-P
description:
Probably Giga-P's most famous song, Bring It On / 劣等上等 (Rettou Joutou / Inferiority Superiority), made for the 10th anniversary of the Vocaloids Rin and Len. This song has quickly entered the Hall of Fame and rightly so as it is one of everyone's (or at least, mine) favorite Vocaloid songs. because of that I knew I had to make a good map out of it. I had a lot of fun making this one and I hope it shows!

Audio edits: extended intro and slight enhancements to the mix has been made since I had access to the vocals and karaoke tracks, to make the audio fit better in Beat Saber.

Preview video:
https://youtu.be/16oSzYCTD3A

BPM: 160
Duration: 3:56
Easy, Normal, Hard and Expert difficulties.

Easy: 335, 7 obstacles, 4 mines
Normal: 469 notes, 10 obstacles, 8 mines
Hard: 665 notes, 14 obstacles, 24 mines
Expert: 845 notes, 15 obstacles, 28 mines

Map includes three different audio versions:
* Full vocal version; the standard version of the song.
* Karaoke version; you can sing along with backing vocals!
* Instrumental version; If you don't want any backing or main vocals this is the version to use.
To change between these search for "GigaP_Bring_It_On.ogg" in your CustomSongs folder and open the folder where that file resides. Change the name of GigaP_Bring_It_On.ogg to GigaP_Bring_It_On_Standard.ogg and rename any of the other two versions to GigaP_Bring_It_On.ogg. Start the game and enjoy!

Thanks to AaltopahWi, RedMagi and ManDynasty for playtesting!

Enjoy!
